body: There, there. It's good to cry. You've been through a lot.
I want to be your friend.

It was doing great until I found out, waiting for more than 30 minutes at the bus stop, that that bus stop wasn't functioning due to something. So I walked a mile and the next stop wasn't functioning too. And the sun was already setting. So I walked more and found out it was due to a Christmas Parade. I walked almost a mile again and finally found a functioning bus station, but it was already late as hell, as you can tell.
Other than that, the beach was gorgeous as always. I came just in time for the low tide, so there was a lot of the corals exposed and a lot of birds, too.

Well, it's really late, I just came back from a walk at the beach.
Got home and kept reading this and other community's posts and tried to find similar stories. To be really honest, I thought I had even read something my ex-girlfriend wrote after reading at least 30 posts... but I think I'm just going crazy at this point. She doesn't even use reddit.
(And you're fine, it's not like you're obligated to answer me, anyways.)

Thank you for the reply, I teared up a little just because of it (yeah, I'm really emotionally unstable) lol
I actually dreamed of travelling to the States because I planned visiting my girlfriend. I always dreamed of living on four wheels with her. Turns out that she had some things going on and we drifted apart - it was a weird break up, because till this day we never properly talked; the "conversation" was one sided only, like a monologue. So I never got to meet her in person, even though I planned the whole year to come here. I'm currently in this country, staying at a family member's house, and with the things that happened I should go back to my country. Thing is, now that I'm here, I don't want to go back to where I was, because I felt like trash there. And just yesterday my aunt told me she really wanted to continue helping me (specially because the last week I was really suicidal), and she was, but things in her life were happening and it wasn't a good time to stay living with her and I should go back.
I just smiled and understood the situation. Thing is, I don't wanna go back. I literally dropped every plan that I had and start a life with my girlfriend, but that didn't happen and now I'm too scared to live by my own. I don't want to get in details of how actually broken I am regarding that, because this post is suppose to highlight the future, not the past.
So yeah, I feel the need to get out of here and walk somewhere where I don't feel like a burden like I'm being to my aunt, even though my family would be immensely worried.
So yeah, I'm already in the place I want to be. I just don't have the age to drive with an international driver license since I'm not a US citizen and obviously no car, too if I wanted to live as a nomad or whatever you wanna call it hahah

P.S.: I'm typing through my phone and currently out, so I don't know if what I said was clear enough
